verses.original: וַיְשִׁבֵנִי֮ אֶל־ פֶּ֣תַח הַבַּיִת֒ וְהִנֵּה־ מַ֣יִם יֹצְאִ֗ים מִתַּ֨חַת מִפְתַּ֤ן הַבַּ֙יִת֙ קָדִ֔ימָה כִּֽי־ פְנֵ֥י הַבַּ֖יִת קָדִ֑ים וְהַמַּ֣יִם יֹרְדִ֗ים מִתַּ֜חַת מִכֶּ֤תֶף הַבַּ֙יִת֙ הַיְמָנִ֔ית מִנֶּ֖גֶב לַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ši·ḇê·nî ’el- pe·ṯaḥ hab·ba·yiṯ wə·hin·nêh- ma·yim yō·ṣə·’îm mit·ta·ḥaṯ mip̄·tan hab·ba·yiṯ qā·ḏî·māh kî- p̄ə·nê hab·ba·yiṯ qā·ḏîm wə·ham·ma·yim yō·rə·ḏîm mit·ta·ḥaṯ mik·ke·ṯep̄ hab·ba·yiṯ hay·mā·nîṯ min·ne·ḡeḇ lam·miz·bê·aḥ
verses.literal: Then the man brought me back to the entrance of the temple and I saw water flowing from under the threshold of the temple toward the east for the temple faced east The water was coming down from under the south side of the temple south of the altar

verses.original: וַיּוֹצִאֵנִי֮ דֶּֽרֶךְ־ שַׁ֣עַר צָפוֹנָה֒ וַיְסִבֵּ֙נִי֙ דֶּ֣רֶךְ ח֔וּץ אֶל־ שַׁ֣עַר הַח֔וּץ דֶּ֖רֶךְ הַפּוֹנֶ֣ה קָדִ֑ים וְהִנֵּה־ מַ֣יִם מְפַכִּ֔ים מִן־ הַכָּתֵ֖ף הַיְמָנִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·w·ṣi·’ê·nî de·reḵ- ša·‘ar ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh way·sib·bê·nî de·reḵ ḥūṣ ’el- ša·‘ar ha·ḥūṣ de·reḵ hap·pō·w·neh qā·ḏîm wə·hin·nêh- ma·yim mə·p̄ak·kîm min- hak·kā·ṯêp̄ hay·mā·nîṯ
verses.literal: Next he brought me out through the north gate and led me around . . . the outside to the outer . . . gate facing east and there I saw the water trickling out from the south side

verses.original: בְּצֵאת־ הָאִ֥ישׁ קָדִ֖ים וְקָ֣ו בְּיָד֑וֹ וַיָּ֤מָד אֶ֙לֶף֙ בָּֽאַמָּ֔ה וַיַּעֲבִרֵ֥נִי בַמַּ֖יִם מֵ֥י אָפְסָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: bə·ṣêṯ- hā·’îš qā·ḏîm wə·qāw bə·yā·ḏōw way·yā·māḏ ’e·lep̄ bā·’am·māh way·ya·‘ă·ḇi·rê·nî ḇam·ma·yim mê ’ā·p̄ə·sā·yim
verses.literal: As the man went eastward with a measuring line in his hand he measured off a thousand cubits and led me through ankle-deep water

verses.original: וַיָּ֣מָד אֶ֔לֶף וַיַּעֲבִרֵ֥נִי בַמַּ֖יִם מַ֣יִם בִּרְכָּ֑יִם וַיָּ֣מָד אֶ֔לֶף וַיַּעֲבִרֵ֖נִי מֵ֥י מָתְנָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māḏ ’e·lep̄ way·ya·‘ă·ḇi·rê·nî ḇam·ma·yim ma·yim bir·kā·yim way·yā·māḏ ’e·lep̄ way·ya·‘ă·ḇi·rê·nî mê mā·ṯə·nā·yim
verses.literal: Then he measured off a thousand cubits and led me through knee-deep water Again he measured a thousand cubits and led me through waist-deep water

verses.original: וַיָּ֣מָד אֶ֔לֶף נַ֕חַל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ אוּכַ֖ל לַעֲבֹ֑ר כִּֽי־ גָא֤וּ הַמַּ֙יִם֙ מֵ֣י שָׂ֔חוּ נַ֖חַל אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ יֵעָבֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·māḏ ’e·lep̄ na·ḥal ’ă·šer lō- ’ū·ḵal la·‘ă·ḇōr kî- ḡā·’ū ham·ma·yim mê śā·ḥū na·ḥal ’ă·šer lō- yê·‘ā·ḇêr
verses.literal: Once again he measured off a thousand cubits but now it was a river that I could not cross because the water had risen and was deep enough for swimming a river that could not be crossed on foot

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר אֵלַ֖י הֲרָאִ֣יתָ בֶן־ אָדָ֑ם וַיּוֹלִכֵ֥נִי וַיְשִׁבֵ֖נִי שְׂפַ֥ת הַנָּֽחַל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lay hă·rā·’î·ṯā ḇen- ’ā·ḏām way·yō·w·li·ḵê·nî way·ši·ḇê·nî śə·p̄aṯ han·nā·ḥal
verses.literal: Son of man do you see this he asked . . . Then he led me back to the bank of the river

verses.original: בְּשׁוּבֵ֕נִי וְהִנֵּה֙ אֶל־ שְׂפַ֣ת הַנַּ֔חַל עֵ֖ץ רַ֣ב מְאֹ֑ד מִזֶּ֖ה וּמִזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bə·šū·ḇê·nî wə·hin·nêh ’el- śə·p̄aṯ han·na·ḥal ‘êṣ raḇ mə·’ōḏ miz·zeh ū·miz·zeh
verses.literal: When I arrived I saw . . . a great number of trees along both . . . banks of the river

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י הַמַּ֤יִם הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ יוֹצְאִ֗ים אֶל־ הַגְּלִילָה֙ הַקַּדְמוֹנָ֔ה וְיָרְד֖וּ עַל־ הָֽעֲרָבָ֑ה וּבָ֣אוּ הַיָּ֔מָּה אֶל־ הַיָּ֥מָּה הַמּֽוּצָאִ֖ים וְנִרְפְּאוּ הַמָּֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lay ham·ma·yim hā·’êl·leh yō·wṣ·’îm ’el- hag·gə·lî·lāh haq·qaḏ·mō·w·nāh wə·yā·rə·ḏū ‘al- hā·‘ă·rā·ḇāh ū·ḇā·’ū hay·yām·māh ’el- hay·yām·māh ham·mū·ṣā·’îm wə·nir·pə·ʾū ham·mā·yim
verses.literal: And he said to me This water flows out to the eastern region and goes down into the Arabah When it empties into the Dead Sea . . . the water there becomes fresh

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה כָל־ נֶ֣פֶשׁ חַיָּ֣ה׀ אֲ‍ֽשֶׁר־ יִשְׁרֹ֡ץ אֶ֣ל כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר֩ יָב֨וֹא שָׁ֤ם נַחֲלַ֙יִם֙ יִֽחְיֶ֔ה וְהָיָ֥ה הַדָּגָ֖ה רַבָּ֣ה מְאֹ֑ד כִּי֩ בָ֨אוּ שָׁ֜מָּה הַמַּ֣יִם הָאֵ֗לֶּה וְיֵרָֽפְאוּ֙ וָחָ֔י כֹּ֛ל אֲשֶׁר־ יָ֥בוֹא שָׁ֖מָּה הַנָּֽחַל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ḵāl ne·p̄eš ḥay·yāh ’ăšer- yiš·rōṣ ’el kāl- ’ă·šer yā·ḇō·w šām na·ḥă·la·yim yiḥ·yeh wə·hā·yāh had·dā·ḡāh rab·bāh mə·’ōḏ kî ḇā·’ū šām·māh ham·ma·yim hā·’êl·leh wə·yê·rā·p̄ə·’ū wā·ḥāy kōl ’ă·šer- yā·ḇō·w šām·māh han·nā·ḥal
verses.literal: Wherever . . . the river flows there will be swarms of living creatures and a great number of . . . fish because it flows there and makes the waters fresh so wherever the river flows everything will flourish

verses.original: וְהָיָה֩ יַעַמְדוּ עָלָ֜יו דַּוָּגִ֗ים מֵעֵ֥ין גֶּ֙דִי֙ וְעַד־ עֵ֣ין עֶגְלַ֔יִם מִשְׁט֥וֹחַ לַֽחֲרָמִ֖ים יִהְי֑וּ לְמִינָה֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה דְגָתָ֔ם כִּדְגַ֛ת הַיָּ֥ם הַגָּד֖וֹל רַבָּ֥ה מְאֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ya·ʿam·ḏū ‘ā·lāw daw·wā·ḡîm mê·‘ên ge·ḏî wə·‘aḏ- ‘ên ‘eḡ·la·yim miš·ṭō·w·aḥ la·ḥă·rā·mîm yih·yū lə·mî·nāh tih·yeh ḏə·ḡā·ṯām kiḏ·ḡaṯ hay·yām hag·gā·ḏō·wl rab·bāh mə·’ōḏ
verses.literal: Fishermen will stand by the shore from En-gedi to En-eglaim they will spread their nets to catch fish of many . . . kinds . . . like the fish of the Great Sea

verses.original: בִּצֹּאתוֹ וּגְבָאָ֛יו וְלֹ֥א יֵרָפְא֖וּ לְמֶ֥לַח נִתָּֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: biṣ·ṣō·ṯō ū·ḡə·ḇā·’āw wə·lō yê·rā·p̄ə·’ū lə·me·laḥ nit·tā·nū
verses.literal: But the swamps and marshes will not become fresh they will be left for salt

verses.original: וְעַל־ הַנַּ֣חַל יַעֲלֶ֣ה עַל־ שְׂפָת֣וֹ מִזֶּ֣ה׀ וּמִזֶּ֣ה׀ כָּל־ עֵֽץ־ מַ֠אֲכָל לֹא־ יִבּ֨וֹל עָלֵ֜הוּ וְלֹֽא־ יִתֹּ֣ם פִּרְי֗וֹ לָֽחֳדָשָׁיו֙ יְבַכֵּ֔ר כִּ֣י מֵימָ֔יו מִן־ הַמִּקְדָּ֖שׁ הֵ֣מָּה יֽוֹצְאִ֑ים וְהָיוּ פִרְיוֹ֙ לְמַֽאֲכָ֔ל וְעָלֵ֖הוּ לִתְרוּפָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al- han·na·ḥal ya·‘ă·leh ‘al- śə·p̄ā·ṯōw miz·zeh ū·miz·zeh kāl- ‘êṣ- ma·’ă·ḵāl lō- yib·bō·wl ‘ā·lê·hū wə·lō- yit·tōm pir·yōw lā·ḥo·ḏā·šāw yə·ḇak·kêr kî mê·māw min- ham·miq·dāš hêm·māh yō·wṣ·’îm wə·hå̄·yū p̄ir·yōw lə·ma·’ă·ḵāl wə·‘ā·lê·hū liṯ·rū·p̄āh
verses.literal: Along . . . both . . . banks of the river fruit trees of all kinds will grow Their leaves will not wither and their fruit will not fail Each month they will bear fruit because the water from the sanctuary flows to them . . . Their fruit will be used for food and their leaves for healing

verses.original: כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה גֵּ֤ה גְבוּל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּתְנַחֲל֣וּ אֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ לִשְׁנֵ֥י עָשָׂ֖ר שִׁבְטֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יוֹסֵ֖ף חֲבָלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh gêh ḡə·ḇūl ’ă·šer tiṯ·na·ḥă·lū ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ liš·nê ‘ā·śār šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl yō·w·sêp̄ ḥă·ḇā·lîm
verses.literal: This is what the Lord GOD says These are the boundaries by which you are to divide the land as an inheritance among the twelve . . . tribes of Israel Joseph shall receive two portions

verses.original: וּנְחַלְתֶּ֤ם אוֹתָהּ֙ אִ֣ישׁ כְּאָחִ֔יו אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָשָׂ֙אתִי֙ אֶת־ יָדִ֔י לְתִתָּ֖הּ לַאֲבֹֽתֵיכֶ֑ם וְנָ֨פְלָ֜ה הָאָ֧רֶץ הַזֹּ֛את לָכֶ֖ם בְּנַחֲלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·nə·ḥal·tem ’ō·w·ṯāh ’îš kə·’ā·ḥîw ’ă·šer nā·śā·ṯî ’eṯ- yā·ḏî lə·ṯit·tāh la·’ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem wə·nā·p̄ə·lāh hā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ lā·ḵem bə·na·ḥă·lāh
verses.literal: You are to divide it equally among them Because I swore with an uplifted hand to give it to your forefathers this land will fall to you as an inheritance

verses.original: וְזֶ֖ה גְּב֣וּל הָאָ֑רֶץ לִפְאַ֨ת צָפ֜וֹנָה מִן־ הַיָּ֧ם הַגָּד֛וֹל הַדֶּ֥רֶךְ חֶתְלֹ֖ן לְב֥וֹא צְדָֽדָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zeh gə·ḇūl hā·’ā·reṣ lip̄·’aṯ ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh min- hay·yām hag·gā·ḏō·wl had·de·reḵ ḥeṯ·lōn lə·ḇō·w ṣə·ḏā·ḏāh
verses.literal: This shall be the boundary of the land On the north side it will extend from the Great Sea by way of Hethlon through Lebo-hamath to Zedad

verses.original: חֲמָ֤ת׀ בֵּר֙וֹתָה֙ סִבְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁר֙ בֵּין־ גְּב֣וּל דַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק וּבֵ֖ין גְּב֣וּל חֲמָ֑ת חָצֵר֙ הַתִּיכ֔וֹן אֲשֶׁ֖ר אֶל־ גְּב֥וּל חַוְרָֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·māṯ bê·rō·w·ṯāh siḇ·ra·yim ’ă·šer bên- gə·ḇūl dam·me·śeq ū·ḇên gə·ḇūl ḥă·māṯ ḥā·ṣêr hat·tî·ḵō·wn ’ă·šer ’el- gə·ḇūl ḥaw·rān
verses.literal: Berothah and Sibraim (which is on the border between Damascus . . . and Hamath as far as Hazer-hatticon which is on the border of Hauran

verses.original: וְהָיָ֨ה גְב֜וּל מִן־ הַיָּ֗ם חֲצַ֤ר עֵינוֹן֙ גְּב֣וּל דַּמֶּ֔שֶׂק וְצָפ֥וֹן׀ צָפ֖וֹנָה וּגְב֣וּל חֲמָ֑ת וְאֵ֖ת פְּאַ֥ת צָפֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ḡə·ḇūl min- hay·yām ḥă·ṣar ‘ê·nō·wn gə·ḇūl dam·me·śeq wə·ṣā·p̄ō·wn ṣā·p̄ō·w·nāh ū·ḡə·ḇūl ḥă·māṯ wə·’êṯ pə·’aṯ ṣā·p̄ō·wn
verses.literal: So the border will run from the Sea to Hazar-enan along the northern border of Damascus with the territory of Hamath to the north This will be the northern boundary

verses.original: וּפְאַ֣ת קָדִ֡ים מִבֵּ֣ין חַוְרָ֣ן וּמִבֵּין־ דַּמֶּשֶׂק֩ וּמִבֵּ֨ין הַגִּלְעָ֜ד וּמִבֵּ֨ין אֶ֤רֶץ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן מִגְּב֛וּל עַל־ הַיָּ֥ם הַקַּדְמוֹנִ֖י תָּמֹ֑דּוּ וְאֵ֖ת פְּאַ֥ת קָדִֽימָה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ə·’aṯ qā·ḏîm mib·bên ḥaw·rān ū·mib·bên- dam·me·śeq ū·mib·bên hag·gil·‘āḏ ū·mib·bên ’e·reṣ yiś·rā·’êl hay·yar·dên mig·gə·ḇūl ‘al- hay·yām haq·qaḏ·mō·w·nî tā·mōd·dū wə·’êṯ pə·’aṯ qā·ḏî·māh
verses.literal: On the east side the border will run between Hauran and Damascus along the Jordan between Gilead . . . and the land of Israel to the Eastern Sea and as far as Tamar This will be the eastern boundary

verses.original: וּפְאַת֙ נֶ֣גֶב תֵּימָ֔נָה מִתָּמָ֗ר עַד־ מֵי֙ מְרִיב֣וֹת קָדֵ֔שׁ נַחֲלָ֖ה אֶל־ הַיָּ֣ם הַגָּד֑וֹל וְאֵ֥ת פְּאַת־ תֵּימָ֖נָה נֶֽגְבָּה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ə·’aṯ ne·ḡeḇ tê·mā·nāh mit·tā·mār ‘aḏ- mê mə·rî·ḇō·wṯ qā·ḏêš na·ḥă·lāh ’el- hay·yām hag·gā·ḏō·wl wə·’êṯ pə·’aṯ- tê·mā·nāh neḡ·bāh
verses.literal: On the south . . . side it will run from Tamar to the waters of Meribath-kadesh . . . and along the Brook of Egypt to the Great Sea This will be the southern boundary

verses.original: וּפְאַת־ יָם֙ הַיָּ֣ם הַגָּד֔וֹל מִגְּב֕וּל עַד־ נֹ֖כַח לְב֣וֹא חֲמָ֑ת זֹ֖את פְּאַת־ יָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ū·p̄ə·’aṯ- yām hay·yām hag·gā·ḏō·wl mig·gə·ḇūl ‘aḏ- nō·ḵaḥ lə·ḇō·w ḥă·māṯ zōṯ pə·’aṯ- yām
verses.literal: And on the west side the Great Sea will be the boundary up to a point opposite Lebo-hamath . . . This will be the western boundary

verses.original: וְחִלַּקְתֶּ֞ם אֶת־ הָאָ֧רֶץ הַזֹּ֛את לָכֶ֖ם לְשִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḥil·laq·tem ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ haz·zōṯ lā·ḵem lə·šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: You are to divide this land among yourselves according to the tribes of Israel

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה תַּפִּ֣לוּ אוֹתָהּ֮ בְּנַחֲלָה֒ לָכֶ֗ם וּלְהַגֵּרִים֙ הַגָּרִ֣ים בְּתוֹכְכֶ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ הוֹלִ֥דוּ בָנִ֖ים בְּתֽוֹכְכֶ֑ם וְהָי֣וּ לָכֶ֗ם כְּאֶזְרָח֙ בִּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אִתְּכֶם֙ יִפְּל֣וּ בְנַחֲלָ֔ה בְּת֖וֹךְ שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh tap·pi·lū ’ō·w·ṯāh bə·na·ḥă·lāh lā·ḵem ū·lə·hag·gê·rîm hag·gā·rîm bə·ṯō·wḵ·ḵem ’ă·šer- hō·w·li·ḏū ḇā·nîm bə·ṯō·wḵ·ḵem wə·hā·yū lā·ḵem kə·’ez·rāḥ biḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’it·tə·ḵem yip·pə·lū ḇə·na·ḥă·lāh bə·ṯō·wḵ šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: You shall allot it as an inheritance for yourselves and for the foreigners who dwell among you and who have children You are to treat them . . . as native-born Israelites . . . along with you they shall be allotted an inheritance among the tribes of Israel

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה בַשֵּׁ֔בֶט אֲשֶׁר־ גָּ֥ר הַגֵּ֖ר אִתּ֑וֹ שָׁ֚ם תִּתְּנ֣וּ נַחֲלָת֔וֹ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ḇaš·šê·ḇeṭ ’ă·šer- gār hag·gêr ’it·tōw šām tit·tə·nū na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: In whatever tribe a foreigner . . . dwells you are to assign his inheritance there declares the Lord GOD
